data.gender_notes: Iviana is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew root ybh, meaning 'to be favored, to be gracious'. Iviana is a name that signifies God's grace and favor in a person's life. In the Bible, the name is associated with the Hebrew prophetess Hannah, who prayed for a child and was granted a son, whom she named Samuel, meaning 'asked of God'. After weaning Samuel, Hannah dedicated him to the Lord, saying, 'I and my heart will always belong to the Lord. For this reason I have dedicated him to the Lord. He will serve the Lord.' (1 Samuel 1:24-28)

data.etymology: Iviana belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's grace, Yahweh's favor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iviana total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
